text:
maria: Posted a tiny Figma diff — updating the console view toggle from 'Grid' to 'Tiles' and using spacing token space-6 instead of space-5. Looks cleaner at 1280px. Thoughts?

devon: 👍 visually this helps. quick question — will this shift affect row alignment in the routes table? could cause truncation on narrow windows.

lee: It nudges the header by ~2px; shouldn't break layout but we should test the 1024/768 breakpoints. I'll run local checks.

anya: Copy nit: across the admin console we use 'Tiles' elsewhere. prefer keeping the label 'Tiles' not 'Grid' for consistency.

maria: Good catch — I'll switch the label to 'Tiles' in the component and in the aria-label.

devon: @lee also can you verify keyboard focus ring after the spacing change? need to keep contrast >= 3:1 for the outline.

lee: Checked locally — outline still meets AA. I'll add a visual regression test to catch accidental shifts.

maria: One more discussion: token naming — space-6 vs spacing.compact-md or spacing.3. I'm leaning to adding an alias for backward compat instead of a destructive rename.

anya: Agree. aliases are safer. if we rename, we need a migration plan and docs.

design-bot: Design file updated: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234 • "Grid -> Tiles" toggle prototype and spacing diff (diff generated by design-bot).

sam: Small UX question: when users switch to Tiles, should we keep the same sort indicator (chevrons) in the header? they expect stable sort affordance.

maria: Yes — keep sort indicator. plan: preserve current sort UI and add a subtle fade animation when switching to make the transition obvious. prototype incoming.

devon: :thumbsup: Also, instead of renaming tokens now, can we expose a CSS custom property like --rdw-gap-tiles and map it to space-6? easier for theming.

lee: PR preparing: #1234 — updates grid/tile styles, adds alias token mapping, introduces a11y tests for keyboard/contrast, and regression snapshots.

anya: Nice. after tests pass let's merge. small follow-ups: ensure copy in settings and tooltip use 'Tiles' and update docs page.

maria: Will do. thanks everyone — I'll push the small copy + figma updates now and add the prototype link in the PR.
